plan.purpose: Resolve the inconclusive W1 B6 cells of the v3.3.1-dev rejudgement by one independent repetition with new seeds (TASKS.md L common rule 2; audit B-E3 FIX; audit C-E9 power).
plan.seed_independence: W1 bench protocol seeds are 31..50; seeds 51..250 were not used to design or select v3.3.1-dev

sample_size_basis.target: seed half width plus MC at most about 0.35 ms

arms.v32: C:/dev/pq_afec_gen32 read only, legacy observe without first-flight evidence, as W1_raw_v32
arms.v331_none: working-tree v3.3.1-dev snapshot, observation mode none
arms.v331_c1: working-tree v3.3.1-dev snapshot, observation mode c1

observer.feedback_loss: s2c_loss when the world feature is enabled

tables.primary: N=131072 L3 joint action pool (seed 850001, family 101)

plan.statistics: bench_report.direct_comparison, 95% Student t over seeds, shared MC 99% bound, regression gate 0.5 ms inclusive
plan.decision: The repetition's primary-table status replaces the B6 status for the adoption floor. The 31..50 result stays reported as inconclusive. No further seeds or N changes. A missing action leaves the comparison pending and the cell inconclusive.
plan.error_caveat: Two-stage use (stage 1 inconclusive then independent stage 2) can pass a truly inferior policy with probability up to the sum of the two stages' one-sided error rates; no simultaneous coverage is claimed.

unplanned_diagnostic_l1_c1_vs_v32.note: added after the plan was written; audit B-E3 asks for an independent-seed check of the L1 C1 B6 cell; not part of the v3.3.1-dev decision
